services.title: How I can help your business
services.subtitle: From a one-off audit to full-cycle performance marketing.

items.title: Paid advertising
items.description: Strategy, launch, and daily optimization of campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads. I test hypotheses, scale winning ad sets, and keep CPA and ROMI under control at every stage of the funnel — from the first click to repeat purchase.

items.title: Marketing strategy
items.description: I analyze the market, audience, and competitors to build a clear 3–6 month growth plan: priority channels, budget allocation, expected outcomes, and checkpoints to track progress along the way.

items.title: Analytics & attribution
items.description: I set up end-to-end analytics from first click to payment: accurate attribution, real-time dashboards, and transparent reporting — so decisions are made on data, not intuition or guesswork.

items.title: CRO & funnel design
items.description: I design and A/B test sales funnels, landing pages, and lead forms to convert more traffic into customers without increasing ad spend — with a focus on conversion at every step of the buyer's journey.

items.title: Team building & training
items.description: I build and train in-house marketing teams — from hiring specialists and shaping team structure to implementing processes and documentation that keep running smoothly without my day-to-day involvement.

items.title: Marketing audit
items.description: A detailed review of current campaigns, analytics, funnel, and website with a concrete list of growth opportunities, prioritized by revenue impact, plus an action plan for the next 30 days.

fit.title: Who this is for — and who it isn't
fit.subtitle: An honest look at who this collaboration works well for, and who it doesn't.
fitItems: You have an ad budget of at least $1,000/month and room to scale it
You need systematic growth over several months, not a one-off project
You're ready to test hypotheses, trust data, and decide quickly
You want less personal involvement in day-to-day marketing operations
You have basic analytics in place, or are ready to set it up from scratch
notFitItems: You need an executor for small one-off tasks with no strategy
You have no budget for paid ads — organic channels only
You expect guaranteed results within the first week
Your product hasn't found product-market fit yet
You're not willing to share access to analytics and ad accounts
